baseline.configuration: The 50 nearest retained training representatives by the declared spherical distance; ties by canonical sample ID in Unicode code-point order. Inverse-squared-distance weighted log1p Cu. Exact zero distance uses the mean of all zero-distance training targets. No tuning.

candidate.configuration: Global mean of retained training log1p Cu. For a known region, mean=(class target sum+20*globalMean)/(class count+20). UNKNOWN/unseen region uses globalMean. Training residuals subtract those means. Predict query region mean plus baseline-identical 50-neighbour inverse-squared-distance weighted residuals; clip negative final log prediction to 0. One fixed candidate; training targets only.

covariate.definition: Intersect the derived component support with GA32366 named geological regions in EPSG:3577. Dissolve polygons sharing the exact trimmed region label; no assay-based relabeling. Use the complete support area as denominator. If documented non-null region coverage is at least 95% and exactly one named region covers strictly more than 50% of support, use that name. Otherwise use UNKNOWN. If differently named regions overlap within the support by more than 1 square metre, use UNKNOWN and report the ambiguity. Do not drop such sites or choose labels by target values.
covariate.prohibited: NGSA-derived PCA, copper/geochemical anomaly classes, mineral occurrences, other measured elements, field pH/colour/lithology, economic features and inferred depth are prohibited covariates. Geological classification is broad source context, not independently observed subsurface truth.

deviationPolicy: Archive this document unchanged. Record mechanical header/parser adaptations with hashes and exposure chronology before scoring; do not change target/covariate semantics, grouping, seed, buffers, representative selection, model, budget or gate. Unexpected source semantics, unresolved lineage/permission, missing crosswalk or insufficient cohorts stop this study. Any substantively different future design must disclose exposure and obtain genuinely unexposed independent evaluation evidence; changing an ID does not reset an audit.

eligibility.catchmentLink: Require a documented crosswalk from every planned target considered for selection to the final GA73085 catchment identifier. Validate linked source positions against polygon coverage, including boundary points. Do not infer the final key by stripping TS, nearest outlet or guessed one-to-one numbering. Missing/ambiguous linkage stops admission before target-based selection.
eligibility.coincidence: After representative selection, exclude all representatives involved in any pair of distinct support components separated by less than 0.1 km between source locations (spherical haversine). Do not greedily pick one member. Keep exclusion reasons and the full pre-exclusion identity inventory.
eligibility.fieldIdentity: Use the pinned GA70478 inventory and its source namespace. Require exact site/sample linkage and complete duplicate references. Ten-digit site IDs are not dates; preserve actual Date Sampled independently. Reciprocal pairs have no directed master role. Reject conflicting or unexplained cross-release identity mappings; do not truncate/pad keys or invent sample positions.
eligibility.geometry: Require complete valid polygon/multipolygon geometry, source CRS, unique source feature IDs and documented class fields. Transform with explicit axis order to GDA94 / Australian Albers EPSG:3577 for areas, grid and polygon buffers. Do not repair invalid topology, fill gaps, invent coordinates or silently omit pages/features. Bind transformation/runtime versions before freezing.
eligibility.order: Build identity/catchment components and fixed representatives; apply coincidence and prior exclusions; assign spatial groups and partitions; apply fixed geometry buffers; only then filter nonquantified targets. All metadata reference sets are outcome-independent. No membership reallocation after exclusions.
eligibility.priorEvidence: Bind complete non-target identity/coordinate inventories for all prior BC RGS2020, USGS DS801 and Copperwood evidence, not only their audit subsets. Exclude a component if any of its source site positions is within strictly less than 100 km of any prior location. Preserve conflicting prior positions; unresolved prior locations require documented geographic/source coverage, not invented coordinates. Trace source/sample lineage; a different country, hash or reanalysis alone does not establish independence.
eligibility.sourceIdentity: Verify exact source/package/analytical links and internal notices; bind raw bytes. Map actual analytical headers/qualifiers to the committed semantics before inspecting target distributions. Preserve all missing/censored records in the provenance inventory even when excluded from scoring. No source substitution.
eligibility.supportAndRepresentative: First combine sites belonging to the same final catchment or reciprocal-reference component. Also merge final catchments transitively when their intersection area in EPSG:3577 exceeds 1 square metre. The union of source polygons is the derived support component, not a new observed geometry. For each component select the lexicographically smallest canonical site ID across all its sites, using metadata only and before checking target availability. Its TOS sample is the sole representative. Do not choose a replacement if its target is absent/censored. Record all excluded aliases and source relationships. This does not identify a physical original sample.

evaluation.budget: Exactly one baseline, one candidate and one audit; no search or retuning. One exact Cu CSV <=64 MiB, one GA73085 shapefile archive <=64 MiB and one GA32366 archive <=64 MiB; extracted data <=512 MiB total. Read package documentation first; no alternate distributions/source substitutions after a failure. Sequential requests with >=1 second spacing, source Retry-After honored, TLS verified and <=60 seconds per request; stop on denied access, challenge or budget limits, no automatic retry/bypass. Local CPU only, maximum two numerical threads, no paid services or unattended AI calls.
evaluation.execution: Before fitting, archive and registry-bind actual source/prior/geology/normalization/evaluator bytes, exact memberships and this commitment. Fit only on train. Bind the training model, validation predictions and audit predictions before scoring audit labels. Evaluate exactly one fixed audit even if the validation gate fails; any attempt after audit start consumes it. Candidate choices never depend on validation or audit outcomes.
evaluation.gate: Qualify only when validation improvement>=0.02, audit improvement>=0.02, the audit bootstrap lower bound>0, and every source/lineage/membership check passes. Otherwise retain the spatial baseline, or record inconclusive for undefined statistics. Passing does not authorize unsampled-region, deposit, depth or economic predictions.
evaluation.metric: Representative-weighted RMSE in natural log1p Cu; relative improvement=1-candidateRMSE/baselineRMSE. Also report MAE, sample/group counts, unknown-region coverage and exclusions. Baseline RMSE of zero makes relative improvement undefined and cannot pass.
evaluation.uncertainty: 2000 paired audit spatial-group bootstrap replicates with NumPy 2.3.5 Generator(PCG64(20261021)). Sort group IDs in Unicode code-point order; draw the original number of groups uniformly with replacement; include every member with multiplicity. Compute pooled representative-weighted RMSE relative improvement and linear 2.5/97.5 percentiles. Undefined replicates mean inconclusive; never redraw. This is grouped resampling uncertainty, not calibrated location intervals.

exposureAtLocalCommitment.fieldWorkbookScope: The complete workbook was acquired and decoded by xlrd; only eight identity/location/date fields entered the inventory. Field pH, colour, lithology, comments/names and other measurement columns were not displayed, summarized or used for selection. This is restricted extraction, not untouched bytes.
exposureAtLocalCommitment.priorResults: Consumed USGS DS801 and BC audit results, selected known-deposit Copperwood evidence, the Yukon method and NGSA sampling counts/methods were known. No consumed audit is reused or retuned.
exposureAtLocalCommitment.publishedAggregateExposure: The initial feasibility search surfaced published BOS coarse total-copper summary statistics and a map caption from https://www.ga.gov.au/bigobj/GA19737.pdf . No concentration-map image was opened. Exact exposed numbers remain archived in the original feasibility review. The related horizon exposure remains relevant; this study is not pristine blinding.

limitations: Published related BOS copper aggregates were already exposed. This is a retrospective design after metadata inspection, not pristine blinding or a prospective validation.

Transported sediment, sparse nonuniform coverage, sampling-access changes and radiation-screen exclusions limit representativeness. Quantified-only regression and fixed representative selection can exclude usable samples; this bias stays explicit.

The 1:5 million named geological regions are coarse. Dominant-area classification discards mixtures, and unrecorded interpretative/geochemical inputs may remain. Separate provenance does not establish geological truth.

Final polygons were adjusted after fieldwork; support grouping is an approximation. Projected distances, coordinate uncertainty, long-range dependence and catchment connectivity beyond the mapped units remain limitations.
The fixed per-partition minima may be infeasible after 250 km grouping and 50 km support buffering. Failure is a valid result; it is not permission to change the study.

Different support, target, covariate and baseline prevent interpreting this score alongside the soil/BC results as a learning trend. This experiment cannot demonstrate improved research-selection policy or verified copper supply.
projection: Reviewed scientific fields from the archived original. Internal implementation bindings are omitted; this projection has its own fingerprint.
question: Does a separately mapped dominant geological region of catchment support improve retrospective prediction of quantified TOS coarse total copper over a fixed spatial baseline?
requiredBeforeFreeze: Verify exact package/CSV notices, schema and field-method/censor semantics; no values may be presented as admitted merely because bytes were downloaded.
Establish the final catchment crosswalk, complete source geometries and current named-region lineage. Resolve NGSA-derived attributes or stop; no unproven 2007 hindcast.
Reproduce the pinned field identity inventory and all prior-source identity/coordinate inventories; implement and test this source-specific normalization and geometry/membership auditor.
Archive exact source, normalized, feature, prior, runtime, evaluator and membership bytes; enforce all fixed minimums before fitting.
Commit training-only model and complete fixed predictions before the single consumed audit; retain negative/inconclusive results without replacement.
scope: Method preparation and released identity metadata only. No NGSA Cu CSV or geological feature package acquired at commitment, no fitted model or audit result, and no verified improvement or supply forecast.
scopeDecision: Use only the original GA82869 NGSA analytical release, GA70478 field identities, GA73085 final catchment shapefile and GA32366 geological regions. Select TOS coarse total ICP-MS as one consistent near-surface prepared fraction with documented total digestion. This choice is based on sampling/method semantics, not the exposed BOS copper aggregates. The baseline/candidate structure is transferred from earlier work without a new model search. This is a retrospective regional comparison, not a 2007 hindcast, prospective discovery test or replacement Yukon experiment.

assay.citation: de Caritat and Cooper (2011), Commonwealth of Australia (Geoscience Australia)
assay.permission: Exact current catalogue declares CC BY 4.0. Inspect actual release notices and preserve attribution before exporting derived assay values.

catchments.permission: Exact current catalogue declares CC BY 4.0; archive actual package notices.
catchments.support: Final catchment polygons, including documented post-fieldwork boundary adjustments. A planned Target SiteID is not itself a final catchment ID.

geology.admission: Inspect package documentation/attribute lineage before joining. Require a documented named geological-region classification consistent with those parent compilations and resolve whether NGSA assays or assay-derived classes informed the chosen current attributes. Unresolved target-derived input or undocumented semantics stop this comparison. Separate publication alone is not proof of independence.
geology.permission: Exact current catalogue declares CC BY 4.0; archive actual package notices.
geology.semanticField: Named two-dimensional geological region, not a depth/time province, mineral occurrence or geochemical anomaly class. Literal field name is to be mapped from documented package schema without changing this semantic choice.
geology.vintage: Catalogue publication 1998 with 2020 citation revisions; metadata creation/revision dates are separate. Lineage names 1978/1984/1998 parent compilations. This establishes historical origin, not unchanged current attributes or a pre-2007 as-of snapshot.

identities.attribution: Commonwealth of Australia (Geoscience Australia), 2011. Workbook: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/au/ ; current catalogue separately declares CC BY 4.0. Baryon derived identity inventory; no endorsement.
identities.reviewedFacts: 1315 ten-digit site IDs; 2630 sample IDs; 248 populated duplicate cells form 124 reciprocal pairs; 1067 singleton plus 124 pair components map one-to-one to 1191 planned targets. No primary member or final catchment identity is implied.

methods.scope: Analytical manual; total fused-bead HF/HNO3 ICP-MS versus XRF/partial aqua regia.
Field manual; sample suffix and sampling design.
Field report definitions and released identity inventory.

split.assignment: SHA256 UTF8 ngsa-tos-coarse-cu-total-georegions-v1|<gridX>:<gridY>; unsigned first 8 hexadecimal digits modulo 100: 0..59 train, 60..79 validation, 80..99 audit. No alternate seed or regrouping.
split.buffer: Using all initially eligible metadata support components, remove train when its minimum polygon distance in EPSG:3577 is strictly less than 50000 metres from any validation or audit support; remove validation when its support is similarly close to any audit support. Fixed reference sets; no restoration/reassignment after exclusions. Audit support unchanged. These are projected-distance buffers, not exact geodesic distances.
split.distance: Spherical haversine for nearest neighbours/coincidence/prior locations, radius 6371.0088 km; clamp haversine term to [0,1]. Preserve source datum/precision limitations.
split.group: Project the selected source site coordinate from documented GDA94 to EPSG:3577. gridX=floor(easting/250000), gridY=floor(northing/250000), group=gridX:gridY. Use mathematical floor for negative coordinates. The component has one representative and cannot cross partitions.
split.minimums: After target filtering, every partition must retain at least 100 representatives in at least 8 spatial grid groups. Otherwise stop without fitting, relaxing buffers, changing group size or choosing another audit. These transferred minimums are feasibility guards, not a power calculation.

target.eligibility: Only finite, strictly positive, explicitly quantified unqualified values of the stated method/fraction/horizon. Preserve raw values, qualifiers and documented detection bounds. Missing, zero, negative and censored results are excluded from quantified regression only after metadata grouping/splitting/buffering. Never substitute a fraction of the detection limit, another method, horizon, fraction or replicate. Do not winsorize, trim outliers or set thresholds using concentrations. Unknown tokens or ambiguous analytical semantics stop normalization; zeros/negatives must not be silently interpreted as censoring.
target.fraction: Coarse preparation fraction less than 2 mm
target.method: Total fused-bead digestion with HF and HNO3, ICP-MS; not XRF, aqua-regia partial digestion or MMI
target.support: Transported near-surface catchment/outlet sediment. Typical TOS 0-10 cm is a protocol description, not a supplied observation depth. Do not synthesize depths, subsurface geometry, ore grade or recoverable metal.

timing: The original local timestamp and exposure declaration are self-reported. Registry recording and public deployment occur later; neither proves external blinding or historical preregistration.
